title: Fix develop CI after wiki titles merge
description:
As a maintainer, I want develop CI green after PR #223, so that wiki titles can stay on develop.

PR #223 merged with failing coverage-ratchet and console-ui.

Root causes:
- Local console uses basePath "" so \`!route.basePath\` never starts snapshot/realtime SSE. Board, Now, comments, and live-update Playwright scenarios starve.
- Wiki delete recovery can leave Home without the remaining titled page.
- Python coverage dropped: right_now subtree error paths plus unclosed wiki frontmatter.

Definition of Done:
- Local SSE subscribes when basePath is empty string
- wiki-ui-006 recovers selection to the remaining page
- coverage-ratchet passes against config/coverage-baselines.json
- PR targets develop only

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Diagnosed PR #223 CI: local SSE never starts because basePath is empty string; wiki-ui-006 delete recovery; python coverage 98.38 vs 98.59 from right_now subtree misses and wiki title edge cases.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: SSE subscribe now treats empty local basePath as valid. Wiki delete refreshes the server list then opens the first remaining page. Added wiki title edge-case tests and right-now subtree error-path tests.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Opened draft PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/224 against develop. Waiting on coverage-ratchet and console-ui.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: CI after first fix: SSE scenarios passed. Remaining: wiki-ui-006 still did not leave first.md; Done column locator matched Done (Legacy). Coverage 98.50, need 9 more hits. Next: local remaining-page navigation after delete, exact column title match, more unit tests.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Coverage ratchet passed. Only wiki-ui-006 remains: after delete the UI was on Wiki Home without second.md because select used a full navigation remount and the in-memory list had only first.md. Select now clicks the listing entry; delete reloads leftover pages from GET /api/wiki/pages.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
wiki-ui-006 still failed after leftover fetch: Then never saw second.md.

Root cause:
- Board view-mode auto-correct can steal the URL on wiki because route.viewMode is null, now that local SSE loads a snapshot.
- A stale first.md 404 sets error and hides the Home listing.
- An empty or failed GET /api/wiki/pages after delete dropped the known remaining page.

Fix:
- Skip board redirects when wikiPath is set.
- Keep leftover pages from memory if the list is empty.
- Ignore stale file loads after delete.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
console-ui on edadecf2 still failed wiki-ui-006 only. Diagnostic: url=/wiki/draft.md.

draft.md is leftover from wiki-ui-004. Delete recovered leftover[0] alphabetically, so it opened draft.md instead of second.md.

Fix on bb6f24e9:
- Open the next remaining page after the deleted path
- Reset wiki storage at the start of each console-ui scenario
- wiki-ui-006 starts empty; wiki-ui-023 locks next-page recovery when draft.md also exists

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: console-ui is green on bb6f24e9. Remaining CI failures were wiki-ui-023 in the Python/Rust wiki simulators: delete still opened page_order[0] (draft.md). Those now open the next remaining page, matching the console.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
CI on 1d02583c: console-ui, python, rust, both parities, coverage-ratchet, and binary-smoke passed.

Only performance failed, during Set up Rust (toolchain 1.88.0 reported rustc not installed). That is an infra flake, not the wiki change. Retriggering CI.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
CI is green on e8918762: console-ui, python, rust, both parities, coverage-ratchet, performance, and binary-smoke all passed.

wiki-ui-006 and wiki-ui-023 recover the next remaining page after delete. Draft PR #224 targets develop.
